questions.stem: Which of the following is a proper subset of {1, 2, 3, 4}?
questions.solution: A proper subset contains all elements of the original set and at least one element is missing. In this case, {1, 2} is a proper subset of {1, 2, 3, 4}, as it has all elements from the original set but lacks 3 and 4.
questions.explanation: Proper subsets exclude at least one element from the original set.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Choosing D, which is not a proper subset because it is identical to the original set.

questions.stem: Is {5, 6} a subset or a proper subset of {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}? Explain.
questions.solution: A subset contains all or some elements of the original set without excluding any. {5, 6} is a subset of {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}, as it includes two elements from the original set.
questions.explanation: Subsets can be proper (missing at least one element) or not (containing all elements).
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Choosing B, which is incorrect because {5, 6} does not exclude any elements from the original set.

questions.stem: Which of the following sets is a proper subset of {a, b, c}? Select all that apply.
questions.solution: Proper subsets exclude at least one element from the original set. In this case, {a} is a proper subset of {a, b, c}, as it excludes b and c.
questions.explanation: Proper subsets can have any combination of elements missing from the original set.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Choosing D, which is not a proper subset because it includes all elements from the original set.

questions.stem: Is {x, y} a proper subset of {x, y, z}? Explain.
questions.solution: A proper subset excludes at least one element from the original set. In this case, {x, y} is not a proper subset of {x, y, z}, because it includes all elements from the original set.
questions.explanation: Proper subsets do not include all elements of the original set.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Choosing A, which is incorrect because {x, y} does not exclude any elements from the original set.

questions.stem: Which of the following sets is a subset of {m, n, o, p}? Select all that apply.
questions.solution: Subsets can include any combination of elements from the original set. In this case, {n, o} is a subset of {m, n, o, p}, as it includes two elements from the original set.
questions.explanation: Subsets can have any number of elements from the original set.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake: Choosing C, which is not a proper subset but rather identical to the original set.
